policy: Reuse verified Blooms names and prose. Correct mechanics against matching official Android and PC 4.1 source. Keep unverified specialized modifier titles Chinese. Preserve all parser templates.

1469.name: Aqua Sword-shroom
1469.source:
凝结时会增强斩击的威力。

<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>前方2格</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时释放<u>利刃斩击</u>；若有充能，施加等级1的冻结状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到攻击冻结/寒冰菇效果时获得1/15层充能</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可消耗1层充能使伤害×2。施加等级1寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值，对冻结的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>刃刃菇+水滴芦荟</color>
1469.blooms_info:
<size=36>Aqua Sword-shroom dishes out more powerful slashes when frozen.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Deals area damage to the 2 tiles in front. Releases a <u>Special Slash</u> when it appears.
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1/15 charge when affected by a freezing attack or Ice-shroom effect. Can consume 1 charge to deal ×2 damage, inflict Deep Chill and 10 Cryo Points and make damage against frozen zombies ×4.</color>
1469.english:
Aqua Sword-shroom dishes out more powerful slashes when frozen.

Targeting Range: <color=#8B0000>2 tiles ahead</color>
Damage: <color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
Special:
<color=#8B0000>1. Releases a <u>Special Slash</u> when it appears. If charged, applies level 1 Freeze.
2. Gains 1/15 charge when affected by a freezing attack or Ice-shroom effect.
3. Can consume 1 charge to deal ×2 damage, inflict level 1 Chill and 10 Cryo Points, and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
1469.corrections: Restore charged opening slash level 1 Freeze, retain explicit level 1 Chill; recipe already present in cost.

1487.name: Mandiboulder
1487.source:
强韧的巨型地刺，还能通过根系进行远程刺击。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有3个外附尖刺。攻击时，额外使外附尖刺攻击全场地表最近的僵尸，并施加扎胎效果。触发扎胎后，该外附尖刺需要30秒再生</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>[融合洋芋]
地刺王∞[地刺]∞地刺王</color>
1487.blooms_info:
<size=36>Mandiboulder launches ranged spikes through its roots.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Titan plant, short plant. Has 3 attached spikes. When attacking, the attached spikes additionally attack the nearest zombie on the entire field. Attacks pop tires. When the main body triggers tire popping, it takes 50 damage, while an attached spike is spent instead and takes 30s to regenerate on popping a tire.</color>
1487.english:
Mandiboulder launches ranged spikes through its roots.

Toughness: <color=#8B0000>1000</color>
Damage: <color=#8B0000>120/1s</color>
Traits: <color=#8B0000>Titan plant, short plant</color>
Special: <color=#8B0000>Has 3 attached spikes. When attacking, the attached spikes additionally attack the nearest above-ground zombie on the entire field and pop tires. An attached spike that pops a tire takes 30s to regenerate.</color>
1487.corrections: Do not add the 50 main-body damage claim absent from actual 4.1 description; retain above-ground targeting; recipe already present in cost.

extra_fields.name: Garlic
extra_fields.source:
大蒜会使僵尸绕道而行。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>受到的单次啃咬伤害不会超过15</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>被啃咬时使啃咬者换行</color>
extra_fields.english:
Garlic makes zombies switch lanes.

Traits: <color=#8B0000>Short plant</color>
Special: <color=#8B0000>Receives no more than 15 damage from each bite. Zombies that bite it switch lanes.</color>
extra_fields.origin: Blooms terms/prose with actual 4.1 source corrections; no added mechanics

extra_fields.name: Hot Pot
extra_fields.source:
借助火势激发上方火伴战意。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每0.2秒限一次，受到火爆辣椒效果时，为上方火系投手、射手等植物回血20并提供持续5秒的50%攻速加成，该加成可叠加、不会在旅行模式生效</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>
extra_fields.english:
Hot Pot uses flames to ignite the fighting spirit of fire plants above it.

Traits: <color=#8B0000>Short plant, carrier, can be planted on bare ground</color>
Special: <color=#8B0000>Once every 0.2s, when affected by a Jalapeno effect, restores 20 HP to fire-type catapults, shooters and similar plants above it, and grants them 50% bonus Attack Speed for 5s. This bonus stacks. This effect does not work in Odyssey Mode.</color>
extra_fields.origin: Blooms terms/prose with actual 4.1 source corrections; no added mechanics

extra_fields.name: Snowbeak (Hostile)
extra_fields.source:
只于笔记中记载的古老雪原生物，因受植物攻击而愤怒。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>200（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>死亡时掉落50阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>激怒：</color><color=red>初始在第6至10列徘徊。被植物方子弹命中或被铲除后，转变为敌方并不再徘徊</color>
extra_fields.english:
An ancient tundra creature known only from old records, enraged after being attacked by plants.

Toughness: <color=#8B0000>3000</color>
Damage: <color=#8B0000>200 (Non-bite)</color>
Movement Speed: <color=#8B0000>Medium Fast</color>
Special: <color=#8B0000>Drops 50 Sun upon death.</color>
Provoked: <color=#8B0000>Initially wanders between columns 6 and 10. After being hit by a plant projectile or shoveled, switches to the enemy side and stops wandering.</color>

announcement.english:
PvZ Fusion 4.1 Update

1. Odyssey: Evolved rework
Earn points each round to buy plants, upgrade the shop, or refresh its stock.
Combine cards or upgrade the shop for higher-quality cards.
Equip plant cards with multiple items for extra bonuses.
Fusions inherit the quality and equipment of both ingredients.
Zombies entering the house now cost HP instead of immediately ending the level.

2. New plants
Basic: Artsy Sunflower, Ball Cactus, 磁性卷心菜投手, 铁桶卷心菜投手, 超时空卷心菜投手, 浮空大喷菇, 大喷菇花盆, 磁力窝瓜, 保护伞窝瓜, 西瓜投射手, 三线胆小菇, 窝瓜大喷菇, 卷心菜投射手, 西瓜胆小菇, 大蒜窝瓜, 银窝瓜, 金窝瓜
Ultimate: SP Calamity-shroom, SP Avarice-shroom, 磁能窝瓜坚果, 飓风之龙, 平行时空树桩

3. New zombies
Variant: 樱桃战神僵尸
Ultimate: 海豚橄榄高坚果僵尸
Boss: 渊海三叉戟

4. Level updates
Super Random: Question Mark Battle: Paint portraits of the random plants Artsy Sunflower attracts, then use them to fight the zombies.

5. New modifier
Shrinking Ray: Mini Professor Cherryz!

6. Balance changes
Blover Pot, Levitater, Sunny Pumpkin: Stats increased.
Tri-pult family: Attack speed reduced.
Buck-nut, Steel Pumpkin, Football-nut: Matching metal items restore much more HP.
Magnet Blover: Digested metal items now become drops.
Calamity-shroom and Avarice-shroom: Effects reworked. Avarice-shroom can now be used on Odyssey's Cursed difficulty.
Tridents: Attacks now slow plants with the Damp status.
Pozeidon: Can bite like a trident and strengthens Damp. The Giant Trident creates a vortex that draws in projectiles.
Trident Jugger-nut Gargantuar: No longer needs to reach the half-HP threshold before throwing its trident.

7. Other improvements
Random mode no longer starts the next wave immediately when the remaining zombies have little total HP.
Improved some plant facial animations.
Magic Plantbrush recognition now runs on a server rather than the player's device.
Adjusted the pacing of points and modifiers in classic Odyssey.

8. Fixes
Fixed Drone Commando disappearing after a scene change.
Fixed Fair Points incorrectly receiving the Cursed difficulty points bonus.
Other fixes and gameplay improvements.
